sed_refresh_labor_readings = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  every_scope_state = {
   set_variable = { name = sed_labor_pool value = sed_state_labor_pool }
   set_variable = { name = sed_labor_committed value = sed_state_labor_committed }
   set_variable = { name = sed_labor_available value = sed_state_labor_available }
  }
 }
}
sed_refresh_direct_budget = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_known value = 1 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_point_cost value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_points value = {
   value = modifier:country_construction_add min = 0
   max = { value = modifier:country_max_weekly_construction_progress_add min = 0 }
  } }

  if = { limit = { any_scope_state = { has_building = building_construction_sector
   b:building_construction_sector = { level > 0 occupancy > 0 has_active_production_method = pm_wooden_buildings }
  } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_point_cost value = { value = var:sed_build_budget_point_cost min = 1750.000000 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { any_scope_state = { has_building = building_construction_sector
   b:building_construction_sector = { level > 0 occupancy > 0 has_active_production_method = pm_iron_frame_buildings }
  } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_point_cost value = { value = var:sed_build_budget_point_cost min = 1260.000000 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { any_scope_state = { has_building = building_construction_sector
   b:building_construction_sector = { level > 0 occupancy > 0 has_active_production_method = pm_steel_frame_buildings }
  } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_point_cost value = { value = var:sed_build_budget_point_cost min = 945.000000 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { any_scope_state = { has_building = building_construction_sector
   b:building_construction_sector = { level > 0 occupancy > 0 has_active_production_method = pm_arc_welded_buildings }
  } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_point_cost value = { value = var:sed_build_budget_point_cost min = 921.666667 } }
  }
  if = { limit = { any_scope_state = { has_building = building_construction_sector
   b:building_construction_sector = { level > 0 occupancy > 0 NOT = { OR = { has_active_production_method = pm_wooden_buildings has_active_production_method = pm_iron_frame_buildings has_active_production_method = pm_steel_frame_buildings has_active_production_method = pm_arc_welded_buildings } } }
  } } set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_known value = 0 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_material_capacity value = {
   value = 0
   every_scope_state = {
    limit = { has_building = building_construction_sector
     b:building_construction_sector = { level > 0 occupancy > 0 }
    }

    if = { limit = { b:building_construction_sector = { has_active_production_method = pm_wooden_buildings } }
     add = { value = b:building_construction_sector.level
      multiply = { value = b:building_construction_sector.occupancy min = 0 max = 1 }
      multiply = 3500
     }
    }
    if = { limit = { b:building_construction_sector = { has_active_production_method = pm_iron_frame_buildings } }
     add = { value = b:building_construction_sector.level
      multiply = { value = b:building_construction_sector.occupancy min = 0 max = 1 }
      multiply = 6300
     }
    }
    if = { limit = { b:building_construction_sector = { has_active_production_method = pm_steel_frame_buildings } }
     add = { value = b:building_construction_sector.level
      multiply = { value = b:building_construction_sector.occupancy min = 0 max = 1 }
      multiply = 9450
     }
    }
    if = { limit = { b:building_construction_sector = { has_active_production_method = pm_arc_welded_buildings } }
     add = { value = b:building_construction_sector.level
      multiply = { value = b:building_construction_sector.occupancy min = 0 max = 1 }
      multiply = 13825
     }
    }
   }
  } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_weekly value = {
   value = var:sed_build_budget_points multiply = var:sed_build_budget_point_cost
   max = var:sed_build_budget_material_capacity
  } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_build_budget_required_gold value = {
   value = fixed_expenses min = 0 multiply = 4
   add = { value = var:sed_build_budget_weekly subtract = net_total_income min = 0 multiply = 26 }
  } }
 }
}
# Country scope; read-only military-economic assessment.
sed_refresh_military_plan = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_expenses value = military_expenses }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_share value = military_expenses_share }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_at_war value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { is_at_war = yes } set_variable = { name = sed_military_at_war value = 1 } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_shortage_count value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_posture value = 0 }

  set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_small_arms value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { market = { mg:small_arms ?= { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_small_arms value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_military_shortage_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_artillery value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { market = { mg:artillery ?= { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_artillery value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_military_shortage_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_ammunition value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { market = { mg:ammunition ?= { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_ammunition value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_military_shortage_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_manowars value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { market = { mg:manowars ?= { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_manowars value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_military_shortage_count add = 1 }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_ironclads value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { market = { mg:ironclads ?= { market_goods_buy_orders > 0 market_goods_has_goods_shortage = yes } } }
   set_variable = { name = sed_military_short_ironclads value = 1 }
   change_variable = { name = sed_military_shortage_count add = 1 }
  }
  if = { limit = { military_expenses > 0 }
   set_variable = { name = sed_military_posture value = 1 }
   if = { limit = { var:sed_military_shortage_count > 0 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_military_posture value = 2 }
   }
   if = { limit = { OR = { var:sed_fiscal_status = 3 var:sed_fiscal_status = 4 net_fixed_income < 0 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_military_posture value = 3 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { var:sed_military_shortage_count = 0
    sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes principal <= 0 net_total_income > 0
    gold_reserves >= { value = fixed_expenses min = 0 multiply = 12 }
   } set_variable = { name = sed_military_posture value = 4 } }
  }
 }
}
# Country scope. TAX_LEVELS is ordered: very_low, low, medium, high, very_high.
# Snapshot before the first change so leaving Automatic or disabling can restore.
sed_tax_policy_save = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes NOT = { has_variable = sed_tax_level_saved } }
  if = { limit = { tax_level = very_low }
   set_variable = { name = sed_tax_level_saved value = 1 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { tax_level = low }
   set_variable = { name = sed_tax_level_saved value = 2 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { tax_level = medium }
   set_variable = { name = sed_tax_level_saved value = 3 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { tax_level = high }
   set_variable = { name = sed_tax_level_saved value = 4 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { tax_level = very_high }
   set_variable = { name = sed_tax_level_saved value = 5 }
  }
 }
}

sed_apply_fiscal_policy = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic
   has_variable = sed_fiscal_status
   NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_manual }
   NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_assisted }
   NOT = { sed_tax_month_limit_reached = yes }
  }
  if = {
   limit = { OR = { var:sed_fiscal_status = 2 var:sed_fiscal_status = 3 var:sed_fiscal_status = 4 } }
   sed_tax_policy_save = yes
   if = { limit = { tax_level = very_low } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_from value = 1 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_to value = 2 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_tax_level = low }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = low } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_from value = 2 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_to value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_tax_level = medium }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = medium } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_from value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_to value = 4 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_tax_level = high }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = high } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_from value = 4 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_to value = 5 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_tax_level = very_high }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { OR = { var:sed_fiscal_status = 1 var:sed_fiscal_status = 5 }
    gold_reserves >= { value = fixed_expenses min = 0 multiply = 12 }
    principal <= 0
    net_total_income > 0
   }
   sed_tax_policy_save = yes
   if = { limit = { tax_level = medium } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_from value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_to value = 2 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_tax_level = low }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = high } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_from value = 4 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_to value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_tax_level = medium }
   else_if = { limit = { tax_level = very_high } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_from value = 5 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_to value = 4 } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_tax_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_tax_level = high }
  }
 }
}

sed_restore_fiscal_policy = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_tax_level_saved }
  if = { limit = { var:sed_tax_level_saved = 1 } set_tax_level = very_low }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_tax_level_saved = 2 } set_tax_level = low }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_tax_level_saved = 3 } set_tax_level = medium }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_tax_level_saved = 4 } set_tax_level = high }
  else_if = { limit = { var:sed_tax_level_saved = 5 } set_tax_level = very_high }
  remove_variable = sed_tax_level_saved
 }
}

  else_if = { limit = { government_wage_level = low }
   set_variable = { name = sed_gov_wage_saved value = 2 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { government_wage_level = medium }
   set_variable = { name = sed_gov_wage_saved value = 3 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { government_wage_level = high }
   set_variable = { name = sed_gov_wage_saved value = 4 }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { government_wage_level = very_high }
   set_variable = { name = sed_gov_wage_saved value = 5 }
  }
 }
}

sed_apply_wage_policy = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic
   has_variable = sed_fiscal_status
   NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_manual }
   NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_assisted }
   NOT = { sed_wage_month_limit_reached = yes }
  }
  if = {
   limit = { OR = { var:sed_fiscal_status = 3 var:sed_fiscal_status = 4 } }
   sed_wage_policy_save = yes
   if = { limit = { government_wage_level = medium } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_from value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_to value = 2 } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_government_wage_level = low }
   else_if = { limit = { government_wage_level = high } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_from value = 4 } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_to value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_government_wage_level = medium }
   else_if = { limit = { government_wage_level = very_high } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_from value = 5 } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_to value = 4 } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_government_wage_level = high }
  }
  else_if = {
   limit = { OR = { var:sed_fiscal_status = 1 var:sed_fiscal_status = 5 }
    gold_reserves >= { value = fixed_expenses min = 0 multiply = 12 }
    principal <= 0
    net_total_income > 0
   }
   sed_wage_policy_save = yes
   if = { limit = { government_wage_level = very_low } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_from value = 1 } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_to value = 2 } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_government_wage_level = low }
   else_if = { limit = { government_wage_level = low } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_change_month value = sed_live_month_key } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_from value = 2 } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_to value = 3 } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_year value = year } set_variable = { name = sed_wage_last_month value = { value = month add = 1 } } set_government_wage_level = medium }
  }
 }
}

 }

sed_coord_capture_supply_policy = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_coord_active
  has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known NOT = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_policy_saved } }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_develop_incorporated_states }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_supply_incorporated value = var:zw_var_develop_incorporated_states }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_ip_incorporated }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_supply_tax_incorporated value = var:zw_var_ip_incorporated }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_institution }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_supply_institutions value = var:zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_institution }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_coord_supply_policy_saved value = yes }
 }
}

sed_coord_capture_advisor_policy = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_coord_active
  has_variable = sed_coord_advisor_known NOT = { has_variable = sed_coord_policy_saved } }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_goal_sol value = var:advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_goal_treasury value = var:advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_setting_treasury_off }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_treasury_off value = var:advisor_setting_treasury_off }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_setting_borrow }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_borrow value = var:advisor_setting_borrow }
  }
  set_variable = { name = sed_coord_policy_saved value = yes }
 }
}

sed_coord_enable = {
 if = {
  limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled NOT = { has_variable = sed_coord_active } }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = advisor_auto_construction_enabled }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_advisor value = var:advisor_auto_construction_enabled }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_expand_building }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_chains value = var:zw_var_expand_building }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_more_construction_sectors }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_sectors value = var:zw_var_more_construction_sectors }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_railways value = var:zw_var_scsab_construct_railway }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_power value = var:zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_admin value = var:zw_var_scsab_gov_admin }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax }
   set_variable = { name = sed_coord_saved_tax value = var:zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax }
  }
  if = { limit = { OR = { has_variable = advisor_enabled has_variable = advisor_auto_construction_enabled } } set_variable = { name = sed_coord_advisor_known value = yes } }
  if = { limit = { OR = { has_variable = zw_var_expand_building has_variable = zw_var_more_construction_sectors has_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway has_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax has_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_institution has_variable = zw_var_added_constructions has_variable = zw_var_labor_threshold has_variable = zw_var_more_construction_sectors_gold_reserves has_variable = zw_var_develop_incorporated_states } } set_variable = { name = sed_coord_supply_known value = yes } }
  set_variable = { name = sed_coord_active value = yes }
  sed_coord_capture_advisor_policy = yes
  remove_variable = sed_mode_manual
  remove_variable = sed_mode_assisted
  set_variable = { name = sed_mode_automatic value = yes }
  set_variable = { name = sed_auto_action_status value = 0 }
  sed_schedule_auto_event = yes
  sed_refresh_national_plan = yes
  sed_coord_sync = yes
 }
}

sed_coord_restore = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_coord_active }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_advisor }
   set_variable = { name = advisor_auto_construction_enabled value = var:sed_coord_saved_advisor }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = advisor_auto_construction_enabled }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_chains }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_expand_building value = var:sed_coord_saved_chains }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_expand_building }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_sectors }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_more_construction_sectors value = var:sed_coord_saved_sectors }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_more_construction_sectors }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_railways }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway value = var:sed_coord_saved_railways }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_power }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant value = var:sed_coord_saved_power }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_admin }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin value = var:sed_coord_saved_admin }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_tax }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax value = var:sed_coord_saved_tax }
  }
  else = { remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_policy_saved }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_goal_sol }
    set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol value = var:sed_coord_saved_goal_sol }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_goal_treasury }
    set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury value = var:sed_coord_saved_goal_treasury }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_treasury_off }
    set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_treasury_off value = var:sed_coord_saved_treasury_off }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = advisor_setting_treasury_off }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_borrow }
    set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_borrow value = var:sed_coord_saved_borrow }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = advisor_setting_borrow }
  }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_policy_saved }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_supply_incorporated }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_develop_incorporated_states value = var:sed_coord_saved_supply_incorporated }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = zw_var_develop_incorporated_states }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_supply_tax_incorporated }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_ip_incorporated value = var:sed_coord_saved_supply_tax_incorporated }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = zw_var_ip_incorporated }
   if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_supply_institutions }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_institution value = var:sed_coord_saved_supply_institutions }
   }
   else = { remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_institution }
  }
  remove_variable = sed_coord_active
  remove_variable = sed_coord_supply_known
  remove_variable = sed_coord_advisor_known
  remove_variable = sed_coord_executor
  remove_variable = sed_coord_advisor_policy
  remove_variable = sed_coord_policy_saved
  remove_variable = sed_coord_supply_policy_saved
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_advisor
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_chains
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_sectors
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_railways
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_power
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_admin
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_tax
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_goal_sol
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_goal_treasury
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_treasury_off
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_borrow
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_supply_incorporated
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_supply_tax_incorporated
  remove_variable = sed_coord_saved_supply_institutions
 }
}

sed_coord_sync = {
 if = { limit = { is_player = yes has_variable = sed_enabled has_variable = sed_mode_automatic NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_manual } NOT = { has_variable = sed_mode_assisted } has_variable = sed_coord_active }
  sed_coord_capture_supply_policy = yes
  if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_policy_saved }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_develop_incorporated_states value = yes }
   set_variable = { name = zw_var_ip_incorporated value = yes }
   remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_institution
  }
  remove_variable = advisor_auto_construction_enabled
  remove_variable = zw_var_expand_building
  remove_variable = zw_var_more_construction_sectors
  remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway
  remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant
  remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin
  remove_variable = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax
  set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 0 }
  set_variable = { name = sed_coord_advisor_policy value = 0 }
  if = { limit = { has_variable = aroai_autobuild } set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 5 } }
  else_if = { limit = { sed_coord_fiscal_safe = yes NOT = { in_default = yes } is_construction_paused = no }
   if = { limit = { sed_coord_reserve_drawdown_safe = yes construction_queue_num_queued_government_levels > 0 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 12 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_waiting = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 10 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_goal = 2 sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes sed_direct_supply_priority_exists = yes }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 11 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { var:sed_plan_goal = 1 has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_construct_railway value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 2 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes var:sed_plan_goal = 6 }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 6 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes var:sed_plan_goal = 7 }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_gov_admin_for_tax value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 7 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes var:sed_plan_goal = 9 }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_scsab_construct_power_plant value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 8 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes var:sed_plan_goal = 3 }
    set_variable = { name = zw_var_more_construction_sectors value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 4 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { OR = { var:sed_plan_goal = 6 var:sed_plan_goal = 7 var:sed_plan_goal = 9 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 9 }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_advisor_known OR = { var:sed_plan_goal = 1 var:sed_plan_goal = 2 var:sed_plan_goal = 3 var:sed_plan_goal = 5 var:sed_plan_goal = 8 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_advisor }
 set_variable = { name = advisor_auto_construction_enabled value = var:sed_coord_saved_advisor }
}
else = { set_variable = { name = advisor_auto_construction_enabled value = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 1 }
    sed_coord_capture_advisor_policy = yes
    remove_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol
    remove_variable = advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury
    remove_variable = advisor_setting_treasury_off
    remove_variable = advisor_setting_borrow
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_advisor_policy value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { principal > 0 credit > 0 principal >= { value = credit multiply = 0.5 } }
     set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_sc_goal_treasury value = yes }
     set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_treasury_off value = yes }
     set_variable = { name = sed_coord_advisor_policy value = 3 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { OR = {
     any_scope_state = { OR = { var:sed_plan_grain_rank = 1 var:sed_plan_groceries_rank = 1 var:sed_plan_clothes_rank = 1 } }
     AND = { var:sed_plan_goal = 5 OR = { var:sed_plan_missing_grain = 1 var:sed_plan_missing_groceries = 1 var:sed_plan_missing_clothes = 1 } }
    } }
     set_variable = { name = advisor_setting_sc_goal_sol value = yes }
     set_variable = { name = sed_coord_advisor_policy value = 2 }
    }
   }
   else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_supply_known sed_auto_fiscal_safe = yes OR = { var:sed_plan_goal = 2 var:sed_plan_goal = 5 var:sed_plan_goal = 8 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = sed_coord_saved_chains }
 set_variable = { name = zw_var_expand_building value = var:sed_coord_saved_chains }
}
else = { set_variable = { name = zw_var_expand_building value = 0 } }
    set_variable = { name = sed_coord_executor value = 3 }
   }
  }
 }
}
